verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents running a 35B MoE LLM, so it covers the LLM and MoE parts of the story. Its model support appears limited to a small set of curated 'tiers' auto-detected from config.json, not a broad catalog of architectures. Missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of architectures, multi-modal model support, embedding model support, and any list of supported model families beyond the edge0-35b tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Run 35B MoE models in ~2.5 GB of RAM.
